description: This file contains unit tests for the Sponsor model class within the Goteo project, testing creation, validation, deletion, and retrieval of Sponsor objects.

classes.name: SponsorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the Sponsor model class in the Goteo project.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests instantiation of the Sponsor object and verifies it's an instance of the Sponsor class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation and saving process of a Sponsor object.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation, validation, saving, retrieval, and deletion of a Sponsor object.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests behavior when retrieving and deleting a non-existing Sponsor.
